# Two Sudirman Private Residences

> Jakarta's tallest private residential tower — 70 floors, 335 strata-title units on Jl. Jend. Sudirman Kav. 2, Jakarta Pusat. Developed by Mitsubishi Estate (Japan), Benhil Property, and Taspen Properti. Architecture by NBBJ (USA), structure by ARUP (UK), interior by Super Potato (Japan), façade by Inhabit (Singapore), landscape by TROP (Thailand), mechanical by Surbana Jurong (Singapore).

## Property Overview
- [Two Sudirman Private Residences](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/two-sudirman/)

## Unit Types
- 2 Bedroom: 175–192 sqm (Level 6–57, Thoughtfully Appointed)
- 3 Bedroom: 256–277 sqm (Level 6–57, Thoughtfully Appointed)
- 4 Bedroom: 308–320 sqm (Level 6–57, Thoughtfully Appointed)
- Sky Terrace: 405–651 sqm (Level 59–70, Your Canvas)
- Penthouse: 708–2,345 sqm (Level 59–70, Your Canvas)

## Pricing
- Low Zone (FL 6–25): From IDR 71 million/sqm excl VAT
- Mid Zone (FL 28–45): Upon request
- High Zone (FL 46–57): Upon request
- Penthouse (FL 59–70): Private consultation
- Payment: Installment, Progress Payment, or KPA (Bank Mortgage)

## Facilities
- Wellness (Level 3–5): Infinity Pool, Heated Indoor Pool, Kids Pool, Indoor Children Playground, Cafe & Lounge, Golf Simulator, Entertainment Room, Full Equipped Gym, Yoga & Pilates Studio
- Lifestyle (Level 42): Town Hall, Sky Terrace, Cigar Lounge, Sky Lounge, Wine Cellar, Private Dining Room, Hair & Nail Salon, Spa & Jacuzzi, Library, Meeting Rooms
- Outdoor: Jogging Path, Tennis Court, Multi-Purpose Court
- Site Plan: Private Residences, Two Sudirman Place (Commercial), Andaz Jakarta Hotel, Retails, Promenade, Active Park, Oasis Park

## Specifications (2–4BR)
- Elevators: Mitsubishi Double Private Elevators
- Flooring: High quality imported marble (living/dining/kitchen), Engineered wood (bedrooms), Imported stone tiles & marble (bathrooms)
- Sanitary: Gessi (Italy)
- Kitchen: Arclinea (Italy) dry kitchen, Toto wet kitchen
- Bathtub: Neorest (Japan) & Knief (Germany) master, Villeroy & Boch (Germany) others
- Wardrobes: Molteni (Italy)
- Appliances: Asko (Sweden)
- AC: Daikin VRV or Mitsubishi VRF with PM 2.5 filter

## Handover
- Estimated Q1 2029
